weather_report:
Subiaco rests under a broken ceiling of cloud at this quiet hour, the air cool and uncomplicated, the streets washed in the soft hush before birdsong and bins on the verge. Overhead, gaps open and close like slow breath, hinting at the pale edge of dawn that will ease its way in soon enough.

After sunrise, the sky should gradually loosen from broken to scattered cloud, letting through long, generous spells of spring sunlight. The day looks pleasantly bright rather than fierce at first, with a clean, well-defined light; by late morning the sun will bite, and the UV will surge to high levels, so plan on sunglasses, a brimmed hat, and a sweep of sunscreen. Dress in light layers you can shed as the warmth gathers. It’s a good morning for a gentle walk to fetch coffee, a quick lap of errands on foot before the glare builds, or hanging the washing early so it drinks in the breeze and sun. A mid-morning read in the park will be lovely if you can find a bench dappled with shade, and later, a quiet pause indoors with the windows open will suit the bright, open feel of the day.
